comparison.objective: Measure tyre pressure with a pencil gauge and return it to its holder; candidate finishes four installed HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Square sealing onto a valve, axial depression, sustained contact, and tool replacement versus bimanual impact regulation and millimetre fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Valid 33–37 psi-equivalent reading after a sealed hold and gauge upright, released in its holder; no fracture or debris criterion.
comparison.reason: Tests sealing and measurement through a valve, not impact fracture of a manufactured tang.
